content.comment_body: Hi, I have a system at home that has operated reliably for over a year. It consists of a [product_name] module connected to an HMI panel via an [product_name] ethernet switch, all integrated into my home network. Recently, I added another [product_name] module in a master/master configuration. The HMI displays values from both modules, and data is exchanged between them. However, the second module intermittently loses network connection, requiring me to unplug and reconnect the network cable for it to reconnect. I tried replacing the module, but the issue persisted. There's no clear pattern—sometimes it stays connected for hours or days before disconnecting. I have even been online with the second module when it lost connection (my PC connects through WiFi, and the ethernet switch links to my home router). Does anyone have suggestions?

Hello [user_name], I suggest checking the following: - Ensure no IP address is being assigned to two devices simultaneously (for example, if a mobile phone connects to the network). - Inspect the grounding system of your setup (central grounding, one-sided shielding). - Review how the network cable is routed, especially near power lines carrying heavy loads. - Check the cable length. If it exceeds specifications, consider using an amplifier, repeater, or additional switch. - Monitor which devices are active during disconnects. Sometimes, even small electronics or phone chargers can interfere with the power grid or network cables leading to the [product_name] module. Regards [user_name] (translated using Google)

Thanks [user_name], It turned out to be an IP address conflict. The new module had the same IP address as a WiFi mesh node. Whenever a device connected to that node, it caused the module to disconnect, explaining the random nature of the issue. Simple solutions are often the ones we overlook!

analysis.insight_summary: Users encountered sporadic network disconnections in their home automation setup involving multiple [product_name] modules. The interruptions required manual reconnection, and investigation revealed an IP address conflict between a new module and another network device. This highlighted the need for careful IP management and consistent network configuration, especially in environments with numerous connected devices. The unpredictable dropouts affected system reliability and convenience.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect stable, uninterrupted network connectivity among all modules and HMI panels, minimal manual intervention, and straightforward networking even as systems become more complex.
